title: Dossier: The Scholar
summary: Wenna Aldric wrote the curriculum every wizard you've ever met was taught from. Her forces fight like a syllabus. Learn where the lesson plan fails.

objectives.text: Cross paths with the Scholar's forces

title: Dossier: The Reviser
summary: Aurel Pendry does not cast spells so much as revise them — including yours. Every engagement is a draft he is marking up. Learn what he cannot bring himself to leave alone.

objectives.text: Cross paths with the Reviser's forces

title: Dossier: The Witness
summary: Hess does not intervene. The land does that for her. Her forces are simply weather with opinions. Learn what she has chosen not to watch.

objectives.text: Cross paths with the Witness's forces

title: Dossier: The Vessel
summary: Joren Kall hosts an argument older than language, and his forces are its raised voices. Learn which of the elements is losing the debate.

objectives.text: Cross paths with the Vessel's forces

title: Dossier: The Namer
summary: Cael Morn builds seven layers into every working, and their soldiers are the outermost one. Learn what the other six are protecting.

objectives.text: Cross paths with the Namer's forces

title: Dossier: The Conductor
summary: The Hostess of the Long Table has never lost a patient in either direction. Her forces have already died once and found it restful. Learn what still unsettles them.

objectives.text: Cross paths with the Conductor's forces

title: Dossier: The Engineer
summary: Half of Bram Korro's devices work. The other half are research. His forces are field trials, and you are the test conditions. Learn which prototypes fail.

objectives.text: Cross paths with the Engineer's forces

title: Dossier: The Astrologer
summary: Kassian Vor-Aleth has no patrols. His forces are the weather, the corruption, the slow arithmetic of the sky. What the corruption takes, it also teaches.
